instruction: Set the minimum number of undo steps to 30 in GIMP.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc from the VM and caches it locally for the metric to read.
Postconfig closes GIMP via Ctrl+Q before evaluation, ensuring GIMP flushes the undo-levels setting to gimprc.

Metric check_config_status correctly parses gimprc lines by stripping parentheses, splitting on whitespace, and checking items[0]=='undo-levels' and items[-1]=='30', which matches the (undo-levels 30) format used by GIMP.
Expected value '30' exactly matches the instruction requirement of setting minimum undo steps to 30.
The harmless 'type:' typo (colon in key name) in the rules dict is never accessed by the metric function, so it has no runtime impact.
Default undo-levels is 5, so the initial state will not pass — good negative-control resistance.
Single-requirement task with complete evaluator coverage.
